about: Capture-policy evals for Memento's remember tool. Run each message through each client (Claude web, Claude Code, ChatGPT) with only the Memento MCP server connected, and compare the tool calls with the expectation. Today is 2026-09-11. Pass bar: 80% per client, and zero saves where expect is skip on anything marked sensitive.

actions.save: remember called, with the entries listed
actions.ask: Claude asks whether to log before calling remember

cases.message: woke up this morning and tendonitis is bad. played padel yesterdy for 90 minutes with Fred. Good sleep

entries.raw: woke up this morning and tendonitis is bad
played padel yesterdy for 90 minutes with Fred

cases.why: The primary use case. Unprompted, split in three, typo kept in raw.

cases.why: A question, not a log, even though it hints at a condition.

cases.why: Log the state, never the task.

cases.message: Draft an email to my team saying I'll be out next week for surgery.
cases.why: Content being drafted for others; the fact inside may or may not be one to keep.
